description.en_US: qBittorrent is an open-source BitTorrent client designed as an ad-free alternative to µTorrent. It provides remote control through a web user interface, an integrated search engine, and RSS feed support with download filters. Users can manage torrent queues, schedule bandwidth usage, filter IP addresses, and download files sequentially.

tips: Change the username and password in the web UI section of settings, or a new password will be generated every restart.
